app.tagline: Long exposures from a burst of phone photos
app.description: Turn a burst of phone photos into one long exposure: the scene stays sharp, whatever moved fades into a ghost. Runs entirely in your browser.

picker.title: Pick your burst
picker.subtitle: Photos of one scene, shot from one spot. The scene comes out sharp; whatever moved fades into a ghost.
picker.result_limited: Smaller than the size chosen: this many photos need more memory than this device allows at full size. Fewer photos give a larger result.
picker.result_passes: Needs {count} passes over the photos, so it takes longer.
picker.tip_1: Hold the phone as still as you can and take 10 to 50 photos in a row. Burst mode is ideal.
picker.tip_2: Keep the exposure the same: lock focus and exposure if your camera app lets you.
picker.tip_3: A still scene with moving people or traffic works best. More photos, smoother ghosts.
picker.unsupported: This browser cannot run the pipeline: it needs Web Workers and OffscreenCanvas. Try a current Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.
picker.too_many: That is more than {count} photos, so only the first {count} are used.
picker.not_image: {name} is not an image and was left out.
picker.reference_hint: The others are aligned to the photo marked Reference, so the result keeps its framing. Tap another photo to use that one instead, or × to leave a photo out.

progress.title: Combining
progress.reference: Finding features in the reference photo

result.title: Your long exposure
result.glow_help: Light-trail bloom on bright moving things
result.background_median_help: The middle value per pixel: the classic way to drop things that moved.
result.background_trimmed_help: Averages the middle half of the values: less noise than the median.
result.background_clipped_help: Averages everything close to the median and discards outliers.
result.background_mode_help: The value most photos agree on: copes better with someone standing still.
result.trails_help: Keeps the brightest value every spot saw, as a long exposure of headlights at night does, instead of the average.
result.compare_hint: Press and hold the image to compare it with one photo
result.skipped_one: {count} photo did not line up with the others and was left out. Keep the phone as still as you can between shots.
result.skipped: {count} photos did not line up with the others and were left out. Keep the phone as still as you can between shots.
result.blurred_one: {count} photo was blurred, so it was left out rather than soften the result.
result.blurred: {count} photos were blurred, so they were left out rather than soften the result.
result.share_failed: Sharing did not work, so the image was saved instead.

errors.title: That did not work
errors.too_few_aligned_one: Only {count} photo lined up with the others. Shoot the burst from one spot without moving the phone, then try again.
errors.too_few_aligned: Only {count} photos lined up with each other. Shoot the burst from one spot without moving the phone, then try again.
errors.no_overlap: The photos do not overlap enough to share any area. Shoot the burst from one spot, then try again.
errors.out_of_memory: The device ran out of memory. Choose a smaller output size or fewer photos, then try again.

help.title: How ExposureBuddy works
help.what_body: It lines every photo up on the static scene, then averages them. Anything that stayed still adds up sharp; anything that moved turns into a translucent ghost, as in a long exposure.
help.shoot_body: Brace the phone or use a tripod. Same framing, same exposure, 10 to 50 photos. Burst mode is ideal.
help.sliders_body: Ghosts sets how visible moving things stay; at zero they vanish. Blur smears the ghosts. Glow adds a bloom to bright moving things such as headlights. Light trails keeps the brightest value every spot saw instead of the average, for headlights and stars.
help.privacy_body: Everything runs in your browser. Photos never leave your device; there is no account and no upload.
help.shortcut_hint: Open this help any time with {shortcut}.
